evidence_kind: selected committed local-source observation; derived conformance questions, not runtime execution or reviewed selection

observations.fact: NooiField allocates eight dense cols*rows*2 arrays; defaults64x64. The later design proposes a sparse vector field.
Decay uses layer_base^(dt*60) and zeroes abs(value)<1e-6. Deposit normalizes velocity direction then applies weights*0.15, discarding speed amplitude.
Emission initializes both owner and origin_presence_id to the emitting presence.
Deflection at another presence changes owner, increments handoffs and selects a target based on the new owner.
Projection retains a separate origin_presence_id; owner_presence_id comes from the current mutable owner.
The later design requires immutable owner once emitted; exact key semantics must be resolved rather than treating mutable owner and retained origin as equivalent.

derived_selection_requirements: Specify whether emitted-owner identity is authoritative origin, mutable runtime owner or a new explicitly bound identity; satisfy immutable attribution and forbid ownership-based authority transfer.
Specify sparse storage and velocity amplitude semantics against the desired design; copying the dense direction-only deposit is not automatically equivalent.
